 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The numbers don't do Sexton's brand of ball justice. Teammates report feeling his influence on the court the moment he checks in. The free agent acquisition guards like a pesky summer mosquito. He attacks like, well, the well-earned nickname he's carried since high school. "They call me a bull for a reason," Sexton said. "Whenever I get out on that court, it's go time. It's no creeping into the game."
